scope: Independent oracle preparation only; no application execution.
inputConvention: Semantic scenario labels are fixture-local, not a production API or canonical item/ability/quest IDs. sourceCaseIds resolve only to the sealed independent physical oracle. Runtime adapters must bind actual authored IDs without changing expected behavior.
inputGaps: T093 character documents, exact demonstrated interactions, ability/item/progression IDs and source-bound compendium entries
T094 party and ability state/UI integration; T095 compendium integration
T096-T103 authored activity documents/handlers, safe return positions and reward identities
T104 native browser/keyboard/text/accessibility checks and later portrait/media/human review
limitations: No implementation is consulted to generate expected answers. Existing independently authored T006/T014 cases provide the physical inputs and literal outcomes.
No new scored networking rule, physical profile, serial protocol, regenerative topology, timing requirement or regulatory claim is introduced.
Case execution remains TODO; fixture audits prove reference/expectation consistency only. Human technical review remains pending T160.

recruits.name: Photon the Firefly
recruits.abilityExpectation: Optical inspection and compatible connection checklist
recruits.conventionalToolExpectation: Inspection scope, cleaning kit and compatible spare
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Record the inspected connection and profile match before changing it.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Expose which inspection or compatibility predicate still needs attention.
limitations: Light transmission is not electrical power.
Inspection and compatibility do not prove optical margin or endpoint service.

recruits.name: Copperhead Snake
recruits.abilityExpectation: Continuity comparison of a copper path
recruits.conventionalToolExpectation: Continuity tester and compatible replacement section
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Compare the open-before observation with a fresh intact-after test after the section is physically replaced.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Expose the remaining required conductor or declared length check.
limitations: Cannot bridge a severed conductor by animation.
The fictional 100 m passive-channel limit still applies; no unlimited repeater allowance.

recruits.name: Single-Mode Unicorn
recruits.abilityExpectation: Inspection of a declared compatible single-mode profile
recruits.conventionalToolExpectation: Matched-profile checklist and optical power meter
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Inspect the supplied compatible optical pair and compare received power and reserve.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Explain sensitivity, overload and reserve separately for the same declared profile.
limitations: Single-mode describes propagation, not one guaranteed payload lane.
No universal distance, superior-protocol ladder or electrical power on fiber.

recruits.name: Multimode Hydra
recruits.abilityExpectation: Inspection of a declared compatible multimode profile
recruits.conventionalToolExpectation: Matched-profile checklist and optical power meter
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Inspect the supplied compatible optical pair and compare received power and reserve.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Explain why multiple propagation modes do not grant independent guaranteed data channels.
limitations: Multiple modes are not guaranteed independent payload lanes.
No automatic compatibility or rate bonus over the supplied module/media profile.

recruits.name: Thunderbird
recruits.abilityExpectation: Fresh radio observation after path/settings inspection
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Record signal and noise separately with the declared viable path and compatible settings.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Compare a later sample with its source and freshness, retaining the scenario limit.
limitations: Signal strength alone does not establish throughput.
No universal best channel or regulatory recommendation; mitigation requires measurement.

recruits.name: SFP Hermit Crab
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Compare every required host, medium, wavelength, rate and connector/polarity field.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Explain the first unsatisfied profile field rather than infer compatibility from a shell.
limitations: An SFP shell is a form factor, not universal PHY or rate compatibility.
A passing power budget cannot override incompatible equipment.

recruits.name: Electric Eel
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Sum declared delivered endpoint demands and compare the supplied delivered budget.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Show headroom or excess while keeping per-port and power-method checks separate.
limitations: Power adequacy does not prove a data link.
Do not subtract hidden PSE/PD losses or make fiber carry electrical power.

recruits.name: Echo Bat
recruits.conventionalToolExpectation: Continuity tester and repeater comparison exhibit
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Observe a fresh intact path after actual section replacement and reject a repeater-only cure for a break.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Explain what regeneration can repeat and why the unchanged open path remains disconnected.
limitations: Does not learn addresses or select IP routes.
No graded regenerative repair topology until separate segment profiles/limits have reviewed cases.

recruits.name: Chameleon
recruits.demonstratedInteraction: Intersect the two declared endpoint capability sets.
recruits.progressionExpectation: Explain unsupported selection and the no-common-member boundary.
limitations: Cannot invent capabilities or unsupported fallback modes.
Physical negotiation is not address discovery, routing or application login.

compatibility.reason: Every declared compatibility predicate and inspection is satisfied; preparation only, not a whole-link proof.
A sufficient numeric budget cannot override a declared incompatible pair.
One mismatched required wavelength direction is enough; identical shell shape cannot change it.

continuity.reason: After actual section replacement, a fresh test establishes the required continuity; length and endpoint checks remain separate.
Repeating a signal without restoring the specified broken medium leaves the path disconnected.
Even one remaining open required conductor fails continuity while the repeater is powered.

optical.reason: -3 - 10 = -13 dBm; 1 dB reserve is below 2 dB even though sensitivity is met.
-3 - 9 = -12 dBm; exactly 2 dB reserve is included by this fictional profile.

radio.reason: -65 - (-90) = 25 dB, at least the supplied 20 dB requirement; other path/settings checks are already satisfied.
-65 - (-78) = 13 dB, below 20 dB; choosing a mitigation is not a new observation.
-65 - (-85) = 20 dB; this fictional inclusive threshold accepts equality.

power.reason: 12 + 11 = 23 W at the delivered endpoint boundary; 30 - 23 = 7 W.
12 + 11 + 10 = 33 W, exceeding the delivered 30 W budget by 3 W.
12 + 11 + 7 = 30 W; the inclusive ceiling allows zero remaining headroom when every other constraint is met.

capabilities.reason: The only advertised intersection member is 100 Mb/s full; no ranking is needed.
Endpoint B never advertises 1000/full, so choosing it cannot invent support.
The two supplied advertised sets have no shared member; do not invent a fallback.
